sources.prompt: Read the email from Nadia. Hi Sara, I hope you and your family are well. Last week our class visited the science museum, and it was great! But I am writing because I need your help. Our teacher wants us to make a poster about the museum by next Monday. I have some photos, but I can't draw well. You are very good at drawing because you practise every day. Can you help me on Saturday afternoon? We can work at the library from 2:00 to 5:00, or at my house after that. My mum will make pizza for us. Please write back soon. Best wishes, Nadia Question: Why is Nadia writing to Sara? (a) to ask about Sara's family (b) to ask for help with a poster (c) to tell Sara about pizza
